capabilities: Fetch URLs into Markdown bookmark notes using Readability, Open Graph metadata, or FxTwitter
Arrange links, app launchers, and note cards on a free canvas with areas, arrows, ratings, and text
Launch local apps and open files or notes by double-clicking their canvas icons
Render the same canvas inline in notes via a web-desk code block
Keep item positions in frontmatter so the layout syncs with the vault
extras: Desktop-only plugin, not yet listed in the community plugin directory; install via BRAT or manually from releases. README is bilingual (English and Chinese).
problem: Obsidian has no desktop-like spatial board where bookmarks, app launchers, and notes can be arranged, previewed, and reopened together.

relations.evidence: If Clipii is installed at its standard Homebrew path, NaviBoard can invoke it to convert supported WeChat and Xiaohongshu pages.

summary: Visual navigation board that arranges links, local apps, and notes as icons on a free canvas, storing each item as a Markdown file.
